name: Kugayama Nanako
source:
Occupation: Voice actress
Activities: Student Council VP
Favorite things: Anime
Hobbies: Dating sims
Special skill: Large vocal range
Problem areas: Distrusting
An elegant and feminine voice actress and idol, Nanako has an intense competitive drive to the best at everything she does. 
Although she comes off as a plain old tsundere, Nanako is not afraid of showing her true feelings around the protagonist should the situation call for it. 
Therefore, she and the protagonist end up confiding in each other.
Her measurements grow up to 106(M)-55-91
